nodes.label: Main Page Moderator Popup Management Design Plan
Responsive Popup Delivery
nodes.rationale: Desktop uses simultaneous nonmodal popup layers so exposed page areas remain interactive, while mobile uses a blocking single-popup queue because the limited viewport cannot safely present the same interaction model.

nodes.label: Revision-Aware 24-Hour Popup Suppression
nodes.rationale: Per-popup localStorage expiry preserves an exact browser-local 24-hour dismissal, while a changed server revision invalidates stale suppression so edited content is shown immediately.

nodes.label: Image and Rich-Text Popup Content Types
Shared Image Editor Boundary
nodes.rationale: Because image editor PR 82 was not yet on develop, the popup implementation should reuse resize and preview boundaries without maintaining two full editor copies.

nodes.label: Recursive Cascading Popup Stack
nodes.rationale: A recursive offset layout supports an unbounded number of desktop popups without flex wrapping hidden items below the viewport or relying on finite inline-coordinate classes.

nodes.label: Seeker Interview, Copy, and Mobile UI QA Fix Plan
Upcoming Interview Cache Invalidation
nodes.rationale: The interview server contract is already correct; invalidating listMyUpcomingInterviews after setInterviewStatus fixes stale UI without changing schema or API state rules.

nodes.label: Two-Row Mobile Chat Header
nodes.rationale: Separating the title from actions and status prevents a single flex row from forcing the job title into an unreadable truncation while retaining desktop behavior.

nodes.label: Dynamic-Viewport Report Dialog
nodes.rationale: A dynamic viewport maximum height and focused-field scroll behavior keep the report textarea and actions reachable above the Android soft keyboard.

nodes.label: Manual Discrepancy Audit
nodes.rationale: The test flow is derived directly from code and isolates outdated or ambiguous manual statements in an appendix instead of treating the manual as authoritative.
